evidence.snippet: In family 12, two affected individuals were found to have a splice donor site mutation (c.607 + 1G > A) in DYNC1I2, which is associated with neurodevelopmental disorder with microcephaly and structural brain anomalies (OMIM 618492).

nodes.description: Both DYNC1I2 alleles are disrupted: a canonical splice-donor variant (homozygous), a nonsense variant, a deletion of the whole gene, or the missense variant p.Tyr247Cys, which zebrafish complementation shows to attenuate gene function. The splice variant has not been tested on patient RNA. The molecular functions bound here are DYNC1I2's GO annotations (dynein heavy- and light-chain binding, inferred by phylogeny); the intermediate chain's binding activity has not been measured for any patient allele.
